exam.title: Lessons online. Exams at a Pearson-approved centre.
exam.body: Your lessons take place online. Exams are taken on paper at physical centres approved by Pearson Edexcel. Our students sit the exams as private candidates. We plan which centre and which series to use around the student's city, subjects and application deadlines. Choosing the centre, registering, tracking deadlines and following up on results are our responsibility, so parents do not have to search for a centre or chase places.
exam.extended: Our exams are organised through our Pearson Edexcel-approved partner centre (Istanbul, centre number 91667) and approved centres in Uzbekistan.
notes: The exam fee is paid to the centre. Your offer states whether it is included in your package.
Not every subject and unit is available in every series. We plan around this.
exam.sessions: International A-Level: October, January, May–June · International GCSE: November, May–June

admissionNote: Entry requirements vary by university, subject and year. That's why we build each student's plan around their goal.

cta.title: The first step is a free consultation.
cta.body: Fill in the form and an adviser will contact you on Telegram or by phone. In the first conversation we clarify your goal, the right route and a package that suits you.

items.title: No foundation year
items.body: With an Uzbek school certificate, most UK universities ask for a one-year foundation first. With A-Levels you apply straight to an undergraduate degree.

items.title: Save a year and its costs
items.body: A foundation year means a year of tuition and living costs abroad. You prepare for A-Levels from home, in your own city.

items.title: A direct route to Germany and Italy
items.body: With the right combination of subjects you can apply in Germany without a Studienkolleg and in Italy without a foundation year.

items.title: A flexible exam system
items.body: Exams run three times a year: October, January and May–June. To raise a grade you resit one unit, not the whole year.
